visitor_spaces_note: Duke also sells $2.00/hour Blue Spot visitor spaces at Circuit Drive (8), Flowers Drive (3), Fuqua (2) and elsewhere; their exact stalls are not mapped.

default_rules.duke_permit_lot: Permit required (gated or enforced). Visitors: use a visitor garage/lot. Faculty/staff/students may buy a daily permit where offered.
default_rules.unnamed_campus_lot: Assumed Duke permit lot (most campus lots are permit-only). Check signage.
default_rules.curb_candidate: Unknown: no signage data in OSM. Many campus curbs are permit, service or loading zones.
default_rules.max_fine_note: Unauthorized vehicles in gated lots are subject to ticketing and towing (parking.duke.edu/parking-regulations).

football.notes: Most West Campus lots reserved for football parking; Blue Zone & Iron Duke lots must be vacated by permit holders on weekend game days. Shuttles from H Lot and GC Lot every 15-20 min. Accessible parking: Blue Zone B-7 and B-4 (Wannamaker Dr).

mens-basketball.notes: Circuit Lots free for Circuit and Chemistry permit owners, $25 for everyone else (cash or advance). Jogging Trail Lot $25 advance only. Iron Duke checkpoints from 2 h before tip-off. ADA: Science Drive Garage level 4, $25 advance.

nearby_non_duke.name: Ninth Street public lot (City of Durham area)
nearby_non_duke.notes: Paid lot near Ninth St; current rate not published online. Check signage / ParkMobile zone.
